{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module CloudSDK.Dashboard where import Data.Text (Text) import qualified Data.Text as T import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE import Data.IORef import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_) import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, catch) import System.IO (hFlush, stdout) import Data.Char (ord, chr) import Data.Word (Word8) import qualified Data.ByteString as BS import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8 -- Cloud SDK shutdown status dashboard -- Renders real-time shutdown progress to an HTML status page data ShutdownPhase = Draining | Persisting | Terminating | Complete deriving (Show, Eq) data ServiceState = ServiceState { ssPhase :: ShutdownPhase , ssMessage :: Text , ssNodeId :: Text , ssCustomLabel :: Text -- user-provided label from orchestrator callback } newtype HtmlContent = HtmlContent { unHtml :: Text } -- Encoding table for HTML entity references htmlEncodeTable :: [(Char, Text)] htmlEncodeTable = [ ('<', "<") , ('>', ">") , ('&', "&") , ('"', """) , ('\'', "'") ] -- Sanitize text for safe HTML embedding htmlEncode :: Text -> Text htmlEncode = T.concatMap encChar where encChar c = case lookup c htmlEncodeTable of Just entity -> entity Nothing -> T.singleton c -- Encode for embedding in JavaScript string context within HTML -- This handles the cross-layer boundary between HTML and JS jsStringEncode :: Text -> Text jsStringEncode = T.concatMap encChar where encChar '\\' = "\\\\" encChar '\'' = "\\'" encChar '"' = "\\\"" encChar '\n' = "\\n" encChar '\r' = "\\r" encChar '/' = "\\/" encChar c | ord c < 0x20 = T.pack $ "\\x" ++ hexByte (ord c) | otherwise = T.singleton c hexByte n = [hexDigit (n `div` 16), hexDigit (n `mod` 16)] hexDigit n | n < 10 = chr (ord '0' + n) | otherwise = chr (ord 'a' + n - 10) -- URI-encode for safe embedding in href/src attributes uriEncode :: Text -> Text uriEncode t = T.pack $ concatMap encByte (BS.unpack $ TE.encodeUtf8 t) where encByte w | isUnreserved w = [chr (fromIntegral w)] | otherwise = '%' : hexByte (fromIntegral w) isUnreserved w = (w >= 0x41 && w <= 0x5A) -- A-Z || (w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x7A) -- a-z || (w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39) -- 0-9 || w == 0x2D || w == 0x2E -- - . || w == 0x5F || w == 0x7E -- _ ~ hexByte n = [hexDigit (n `div` 16), hexDigit (n `mod` 16)] hexDigit n | n < 10 = chr (ord '0' + n) | otherwise = chr (ord 'A' + n - 10) -- Build the shutdown status fragment -- The nodeId is system-generated (trusted), customLabel comes from orchestrator API renderStatusFragment :: ServiceState -> HtmlContent renderStatusFragment st = HtmlContent $ T.concat [ "
\n" , "

Node: ", htmlEncode (ssNodeId st), "

\n" , "

", htmlEncode (ssMessage st), "

\n" , renderLabelWidget (ssCustomLabel st) , "
\n" ] -- The label widget uses a progressive enhancement pattern: -- Static HTML for the label, plus a JS snippet for live updates. -- The label is encoded for JS context and uses textContent for safe DOM update. renderLabelWidget :: Text -> Text renderLabelWidget label = T.concat [ " ", htmlEncode label, "\n" , " \n" ] -- Graceful shutdown handler that updates the dashboard data ShutdownManager = ShutdownManager { smState :: MVar ServiceState , smRender :: ServiceState -> HtmlContent } newShutdownManager :: Text -> Text -> IO ShutdownManager newShutdownManager nodeId initialLabel = do stateVar <- newMVar ServiceState { ssPhase = Draining , ssMessage = "Initiating graceful shutdown" , ssNodeId = nodeId , ssCustomLabel = initialLabel } return ShutdownManager { smState = stateVar , smRender = renderStatusFragment } -- Called by orchestrator with user-provided label updates during shutdown updateLabel :: ShutdownManager -> Text -> IO () updateLabel mgr newLabel = modifyMVar_ (smState mgr) $ \st -> return st { ssCustomLabel = newLabel } advancePhase :: ShutdownManager -> IO () advancePhase mgr = modifyMVar_ (smState mgr) $ \st -> let nextPhase = case ssPhase st of Draining -> Persisting Persisting -> Terminating Terminating -> Complete Complete -> Complete nextMsg = case nextPhase of Persisting -> "Flushing state to durable storage" Terminating -> "Closing connections" Complete -> "Shutdown complete" _ -> ssMessage st in return st { ssPhase = nextPhase, ssMessage = nextMsg } -- Get current dashboard HTML getDashboardHtml :: ShutdownManager -> IO Text getDashboardHtml mgr = do st <- readMVar (smState mgr) return $ unHtml $ smRender mgr st
